_comment: Shared contract for the number extraction in scripts/sample_numeric.py and worker/src/numsample.ts. `exprs` is the exact list of expressions found (after NFKC), in order. Rows are numbers with a unit or a comparison; page/figure/table/edition/year numbers and numbers that continue a word are not rows.
